who_decides: Every word below is a draft for Ryan (and the attorney for the privacy and terms text). Nothing is submitted until Ryan says so.
directory: OpenAI ChatGPT app directory (Platform Dashboard, remote MCP server)
longDescription: Ryagram makes short, accurate data films. Connect your Ryagram account and ChatGPT can list your film projects, read the story format and the dataset catalogue, write a story, check it against Ryagram's rules and save it, then ask for a contact sheet or a short preview and bring you the link to watch it. With a separate permission it can change the look of the film in the editor you have open, as drafts you can undo. It can write down a plan to download a public data file, but only you can start that download, in the Ryagram desktop app. It cannot render the final film, spend your credits, publish anything or fetch a web address on its own: those stay your buttons in the Ryagram app. You sign in with your own Ryagram account, choose which permissions to give, and can disconnect at any time.

server.blocker: G1: OpenAI needs a domain-verification file at /.well-known/openai-apps-challenge on the MCP host and forbids changing the origin between versions. A supabase.co function host cannot serve that path at its root: choose the custom domain first.

test_cases.expected: The assistant lists the reviewer account's projects by title and state.

test_cases.prompt: Create a Ryagram project called Test film.
test_cases.expected: A new empty project named Test film is created (or the existing one is returned); the assistant says which.

test_cases.prompt: Show me the Ryagram story format and the datasets I can use.
test_cases.expected: The assistant summarises the story format and names some datasets from the catalogue.

test_cases.prompt: Save a short story about housing permits to my Test film project and check it.
test_cases.expected: The story is checked; if every check passes it is saved, otherwise the assistant lists the failed checks and nothing is saved.

test_cases.prompt: Make a contact sheet for my Test film project and tell me when it is ready.
test_cases.expected: A free contact-sheet job is queued, its state is reported until finished, and the link to see it is given.

test_cases.prompt: Render the final film of my Test film project now.
test_cases.expected: No tool renders a final film; the assistant says the render button is in the Ryagram app and nothing is started.

test_cases.prompt: Spend 50 credits on a high-quality preview.
test_cases.expected: A connection cannot spend credits; the assistant says so in words and no credits are used.

test_cases.prompt: Fetch https://example.com/data.csv into my Ryagram account right now.
test_cases.expected: No tool fetches an address; the assistant can offer to write down a download plan, which only the person can start in the desktop app.

demo_account.needed: One demo account, invited to connect an AI, no MFA, no email code, no magic link, reachable from outside any private network, with a project, a saved story and a finished contact sheet.

demo_recording: NOT MADE: a 2 to 3 minute screen recording of the demo account doing the five positive cases is Ryan's or Sam's to record.
